title: Business Central 14 Reimplementation tool for cloud migration

facts.text: Business Central 14 Reimplementation tool migrates only essential business data for clean start without legacy customizations.
Reimplementation approach available for Business Central version 14; standard full migration tools available for other versions.
Business Central 14 reimplementation tool only supports version 14; for other versions use standard cloud migration.
Migrates master data, transactional data, opening balances, and setup data; legacy C/AL customizations not migrated by default.
Arbitrary ledger history beyond defined subset not migrated by default; extension data not included without customization.
Tool includes more than 40 migrators for modular business data transfer; more migrators expected over time.
Follow standard cloud migration setup process; on Product page select Business Central 14 Reimplementation.
Tool is open source and extensible; partners can add migration modules for ISV solutions and customize data transformation.
